acceptanceResults: EN: All seven Phase 2-8 phase documents and all seven Phase 2-8 PROPOSED design specs contain Japanese-only content (English and Chinese sections removed). EN: docs/glossary.md and docs/architecture/domain-model.md keep their pre-existing Phase 0/1 English/Japanese/Chinese content unchanged, with only the Phase 2-8 entries removed from the English and Chinese sections; docs/README.md's English and Chinese phase lists revert to ending at Phase 1 while the Japanese list keeps Phase 1-8. JA: docs/glossary.md と docs/architecture/domain-model.md の既存 Phase 0/1 の英語/日本語/中文 content は無変更のまま、Phase 2-8 の項目だけを英語・中文 section から削除する。docs/README.md の英語・中文 phase list は Phase 1 で終わるよう戻し、日本語 list は Phase 1-8 を保つ。ZH: docs/glossary.md 与 docs/architecture/domain-model.md 保持既有 Phase 0/1 的英文/日语/中文内容不变，仅将 Phase 2-8 条目从英文与中文 section 中移除；docs/README.md 的英文与中文阶段列表恢复到仅到 Phase 1，日语列表保留 Phase 1-8。

EN: cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace and bash tests/architecture/check-boundaries.sh all still pass, confirming this is a documentation-only change. taskOverview.text: EN: A person reading any Phase 2-8 phase document or design spec sees Japanese-only content; docs/glossary.md and docs/architecture/domain-model.md keep their pre-existing Phase 0/1 English/Japanese/Chinese sections intact, with only the Phase 2-8 rows/sections removed from the English and Chinese sections (kept only in Japanese); docs/README.md's English and Chinese phase lists end at Phase 1 again, while the Japanese list keeps Phase 1-8. JA: Phase 2-8 の phase document や design spec を読むと日本語のみの内容が表示される。docs/glossary.md と docs/architecture/domain-model.md は既存の Phase 0/1 の英語/日本語/中文 section をそのまま保ち、Phase 2-8 の行/section だけを英語・中文 section から削除し日本語にのみ残す。docs/README.md の英語・中文の phase list は Phase 1 で終わるように戻し、日本語 list だけが Phase 1-8 を保つ。AGENTS.md の documentation rule は変更せず、ソースコードの変更も行わない。ZH: 阅读任何 Phase 2-8 阶段文档或设计规格时看到的都是仅日语内容；docs/glossary.md 与 docs/architecture/domain-model.md 保留既有 Phase 0/1 的英文/日语/中文 section 不变，仅将 Phase 2-8 的行/section 从英文与中文 section 中移除（只保留在日语中）；docs/README.md 的英文与中文阶段列表恢复到仅到 Phase 1，日语列表保留 Phase 1-8。AGENTS.md 的文档规则不变，且不涉及任何源代码改动。
